### Freedom in Christ
Author: Robrenna Redl
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/freedom-in-christ-wholly-loved-june-5.html
Passage: Galatians 5:1
Points:
- Christ secured complete freedom for believers through His sacrifice, ending the need to strive for divine acceptance.
- Gospel freedom releases Christians from legalism and external rule-keeping, turning duty into heartfelt obedience.
- Resting in Christ frees believers from perfectionism and the burden of conforming to cultural expectations.
- Christians are called to actively stand in that liberty rather than returning to old spiritual bondages.

### How to Serve with Love (Galatians 5:13)
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-september-15.html
Passage: Galatians 5:13
Points:
- Christian freedom is not a license to indulge sinful habits, but a calling to serve others.
- Serving others without genuine love leads to resentment, burnout, and damaged relationships.
- Human willpower alone cannot sustain the selfless, patient love described in Scripture.
- Believers must invite the Holy Spirit each day to provide the power needed to serve others lovingly.

### Free at Last
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/free-at-last-girlfriends-in-god-july-4-2014.html
Passage: Galatians 5:1
Points:
- God placed an innate longing for liberty inside every person, which can only be met through Him.
- True freedom begins with a personal relationship with Christ, who breaks the grip of sin and condemnation.
- Experiencing daily freedom requires active obedience to lay aside ensnaring sins and harmful attitudes.
- Grasping our God-given identity and worth releases us from the trap of human approval and expectations.

### Maintaining Your Freedom
Author: Freedom in Christ Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/dailyinchrist/daily-in-christ-7-or-4-544644.html
Passage: Galatians 5:1
Points:
- Freedom over sin and the enemy is the inheritance purchased for every believer by Christ on the cross.
- While eternal salvation remains secure in Christ, daily victory requires standing firm in the faith.
- Christians have a personal responsibility to maintain a right relationship with God and resist spiritual drift.
- Focusing on God's sovereignty and our secure identity in Christ protects against spiritual deception.
